title: Identification of Industrial Area along Bukit Batok Street 23 as Funeral Parlour Site
what_it_is: Identification of Industrial Area along Bukit Batok Street 23 as Funeral Parlour Site

sections.label: Rising demand for wake spaces
sections.summary: Demand for wake spaces is expected to rise as resident deaths are projected to double to around 40,000 annually by 2040.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The demand for wake spaces is expected to rise in tandem with the increase in resident deaths, which is projected to double to around 40,000 annually by 2040.

sections.label: Factors in selecting sites
sections.summary: Sites were selected after considering surrounding development plans, road network capacity for anticipated traffic, and public transport accessibility.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The sites were selected after considering factors, such as development plans for the surrounding area, the capacity of the road network to support the anticipated traffic, and accessibility to public transport.

sections.label: Measures for proposed funeral parlour
sections.summary: NEA will require the operator to minimise impact on residents and stakeholders through measures such as barriers, eco-friendly burners, and sufficient parking.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: NEA will require the proposed funeral parlour operator to put in place measures to minimise impact on the residents and other nearby stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: These measures can include barriers, such as plantings and setback from the road to keep funeral activities discreet, and the provision of eco-friendly burners to minimise smoke emissions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The relevant agencies have assessed that the road network in this area is able to support the funeral parlour development and will require the operator to provide sufficient parking facilities within the site.

sections.label: After-death facilities as social infrastructure
sections.summary: After-death facilities are recognised as an important social infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: One of the important things we want to recognise is that after-death facilities are an important social infrastructure.

sections.label: Preparing and consulting on facilities
sections.summary: With resident deaths likely to double, spaces must be provided, advisors and grassroots consulted, and disturbances mitigated as far as possible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Given all that, and the fact that, like I mentioned just now, the number of resident deaths is likely to double, we have to prepare now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have to make sure that we provide for the spaces and give ample notice to everyone who is, in a way, affected by the presence of such social facilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We will definitely consult the advisors as well as the grassroots to help us communicate with the residents and, at the same time, get feedback on the kind of concerns they may have.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We will try, as far as possible, to mitigate the disturbances and disamenities that consequently can arise from putting such facilities near them.
